leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of , Pokémon Journeys: The Series, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-third season of , Pokémon Journeys: The Series, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Pokémon Journeys: The Series Collections were released by VIZ Media and distributed through . 

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Journey Starts Today!===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Journey Starts Today! was released on DVD on January 11, 2022 by VIZ Media and distributed through Warner Home Video. It contains two discs, with 16 episodes across them combined. Optional English closed captioning is included.

Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature.

====Contents====
 
 

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Destination: Coronation!===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Destination: Coronation! was released on DVD on April 5, 2022 by VIZ Media and distributed through Warner Home Video. It contains two discs, with 16 episodes across them combined. Optional English closed captioning is included.

Clean versions of the opening and ending themes are included as a special feature.

====Contents====
 
 

===Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Legends of Galar===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - Legends of Galar was released on DVD on July 12, 2022 by VIZ Media and distributed through Warner Home Video. It contains two discs, with 16 episodes across them combined. Optional English closed captioning is included.

====Contents====
 
 

=== The Complete Collection ===
 
Pokémon Journeys: The Series - The Complete Collection was released on DVD on July 17, 2025 by VIZ Media with distribution through Warner Home Video. This release contains six discs with all 48 episodes in total. Optional English closed captioning is included.
